# Pinstripe

> Pinstripe is the code style for the Wayne State app stack: shared presets for Pint, PHPStan with Larastan, Rector, ESLint and Prettier. Your app runs them locally, and Preflight runs them in CI.

**Sharp code. Every line.**

The coding standard for the Wayne State app stack: shared presets for Pint, PHPStan (with Larastan for Laravel), Rector,
and ESLint with Prettier. Your app points at them and adds only its own exceptions. Pinstripe is to code what a good
suit is to a job interview: nobody notices it, everybody notices when it's missing.

**Not to be confused with:** Pinstripe is the code style settings you run locally; Preflight runs them, and PROCTOR, in CI.
Pinstripe's Rector set modernises code within the app's current PHP version, while Booster upgrades the app to a newer
PHP version.

Checks: `composer ci` (the same command runs on GitLab and GitHub).

Documentation: the docs site is at [`site/docs/index.html`](https://github.com/waynestate/pinstripe/blob/HEAD/site/docs/index.html), built from `docs/` by Squire's shared builder and kept current by `composer ci`. The pages wear the front page's look through `docs/_header.html` and `docs/theme/pinstripe.css`: edit those two files, never the vendored kit.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

- [Tested with and tool floors | Pinstripe docs](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/docs/reference/tested-with.md): The tool versions Pinstripe is tested with, and the floors each tool needs.
- [Upgrading | Pinstripe docs](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/docs/upgrading.md): How to upgrade Pinstripe, version by version.

## Prompts

- [Get started with Pinstripe](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): Works out what kind of app this is and which presets fit, then lists every file it would add. It changes nothing yet. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Pinstripe in a raw PHP app](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-raw-php): Adds Pint with PER, PHPStan at level 8 and the Composer scripts, plus a baseline if existing code fails. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Pinstripe in a Laravel app](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-laravel): Adds Laravel's Pint preset and PHPStan with Larastan. It works for Blade apps and Inertia apps. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Pinstripe on the Vue side](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-vue): Adds the ESLint and Prettier presets to your Vue front end and reports the accessibility findings first. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
